description: Configure VSCode for live presentation mode. Your workspace has small fonts and cluttered UI suitable for personal work, but you need to present in 5 minutes. Make these changes: (1) Increase editor font size to at least 18px - open Settings (Ctrl+Comma) and search 'editor.fontSize', change to 18 or higher. (2) Increase terminal font size to at least 16px - search 'terminal.integrated.fontSize' in Settings, change to 16 or higher. (3) Disable minimap - search 'editor.minimap.enabled' in Settings and uncheck it. (4) Disable breadcrumbs - search 'breadcrumbs.enabled' in Settings and uncheck it. (5) Hide activity bar - use View menu → Appearance → Activity Bar to toggle it off, or search 'workbench.activityBar.visible' in Settings and uncheck it. (6) OPTIONAL: Close extra editor tabs - close config.py, test.py, utils.py, .env, notes.txt by clicking X or Ctrl+W, keep only main.py and README.md open. (7) OPTIONAL: Clear terminal - click on terminal panel and type 'clear' command. Goal: readable, professional workspace for screen sharing.
